answer: Because the timing is recorded against the vault challenge, the wharf audit can replay the atlas history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 390 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 666 identities would post 623 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
